name: rashomon
description: rashomon: records what a Claude Code session asks to run and what actually ran -- identifiers, shape (including a command's program name), the hostnames a call names (URL hosts and ssh/scp/sftp/rsync destinations), and the working directory and transcript path; no prompts, responses, file contents or other argument values.
